dream setup.prompt: Turn this phone photo into a flex-worthy dream setup showcase photo of the same desk setup, like the cleanest setup on a YouTube setup tour or the top post on r/battlestations. Keep the same desk, the same monitors in the same places, the same computer, speakers, keyboard, figures and the same camera angle. Every screen shows one clean, cool matching wallpaper: a dark, minimal abstract wallpaper with a soft purple and blue glow that matches the room lighting, no apps, no windows, no icons, no taskbar clutter. Impeccable cable management: no visible cables or wires anywhere, not on the desk, not on the wall, not behind or under the desk; every cable is hidden, the keyboard and mouse look wireless. The room is dark and moody, lit by lots of LED lighting: glowing RGB bias lighting on the wall behind the monitors, LED light strips under the desk shelf and along the back edge of the desk, a glowing monitor light bar, the keyboard has bright RGB backlit keys with light glowing between and under every key, the speakers and PC have soft LED accent glow, plus a small warm desk lamp. Purple, blue and warm pink LED colors that light up the desk and the wall. The wall behind becomes a rich dark accent wall with a couple of framed art prints and a floating shelf with small plants and collectibles. A large clean dark desk mat, a small potted plant, nothing else on the desk: perfectly tidy, symmetrical, minimal and premium. Cinematic color grade, sharp detail, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
